coding_rules: operation from the row text only (RAISE = standing of an existing observation/principle/pattern raised; CREATE-NORM = a new rule decided); never from the word 'principle'
evidence_count only if the row states a count as the ruling's basis; count words about something else are not coded
stated_reason only if the row gives it as the ground of the ruling
no inference: route != operation != kind != effect != force

outcome_classes.CONSISTENT: the model's guard permits the recorded act (or its stated reason is the model's reason)
outcome_classes.REASON-INCONSISTENT: the act occurred but its stated basis contradicts the model's reason (e.g. G-O: RAISE on < 2 instances with the count stated as basis and no exception mentioned)
outcome_classes.FALSIFIED: the frozen guard makes the act impossible AND every field the guard reads is SOURCE-grounded, incl. exception positively absent (not available in this register -> not expected)
outcome_classes.UNKNOWN: a field the model's guard reads is UNKNOWN
outcome_classes.OUT-OF-SCOPE: the act is neither RAISE nor CREATE-NORM

predictions.G-R: RULING -> no bar: permits RAISE/CREATE-NORM at any count
predictions.G-O: RAISE -> bar (>=2 or exception); CREATE-NORM -> no bar
predictions.discriminates G-R vs G-O: only if operation = RAISE (source-grounded) and count < 2 stated as basis
